note: route_as: for a call of t_min..t_max tokens the shape-owned table is asked at T' (ops/common/shape_routes.h); measured with ninferno_linear_route_sweep_bench --random-weight --no-class-table, every override bit-identical to the table's own choice; evidence_us rows are [T, table us, override us], mean over 2 passes; min gain 5.0%, 2.1 us. The entries with "bands" (and "prefill") are the any-geometry generic path's, tuned per model on the RTX 5080 with ninferno_route_tune (--samples 11); "tuned_on" names the model whose problems they are. Entries with "claim": true take a problem whose shape also has a shape-owned Linear table (the dispatcher's first choice) at the widths their bands and prefill route cover, under an A16Only policy only: Qwen3.6-27B's five FP8 shapes, whose owned table computes A16 in chunks of 11 tokens (attn_in 14336x5120 at T=512: 4290.6 us owned, 1054.7 us generic; 940f/942f, RTX 5080); a band is claimed only where the generic route was at least 5% faster at the measured widths it covers.
moe_note: moe: the generic MoE Op (ops/moe) per exact layer; "prefill" serves every call of 17 tokens or more under the prefill profile, chosen from ninferno_moe_bench --plans sweep --prefill as the token-invariant plan with the lowest geometric mean of time over the best plan at T = 17..2048; evidence_us rows are [T, default plan us, this plan us], median of the bench. Decode keeps the default plans (within 0-7 %) except where a layer lists "bands": the NemotronH IQ3_XXS layer (Relu2, H 2816, F 2048) chose per T from ninferno_moe_bench --plans sweep (A16 and A8) on Stage::Up, 15-22 % under the default plans at T = 1..12.
